scope: WRF-v4 selected ALB1, BTR2/3, RSF2/3/4, SNF2-5, DVEG1/2/3/5/6/7/8/9, INF2, RUN1/2/4/6/7/8 with INFDV1/2/3, SOIL2/3, RAD1/2, FRZ2, STC2/3, TBOT1, CRS2 and SFC2; strict real native module replays and complete forecast qualification; per-row limits in README.md; native soil cadence and its nine persisted accumulators; native TDRN1/2 with complete simple and Hooghoudt drainage; full module_diag_misc Noah-MP output accumulator block; complete native CROP1 growth/calendar, IRR1/2/3 and every IRRM method, and selected GLA2 real Greenland qualification; complete RUN5 Miguez-Macho/Fan groundwater cold initialization, eight-neighbor flow, WTABLE/UPDATEWTD and native WTDDT cadence

dynamic_vic.licence: Pinned WRF v4 public-domain distribution; no new source or tables. Actual BBVIC/BDVIC/GDVIC from transferred native MPTABLE.
dynamic_vic.translation: Complete DYNAMIC_VIC, RR1, RR2, Philip, Green-Ampt and Smith-Parlange; offline expression-tree generator; native iteration bounds and labels retained.
dynamic_vic.undefined_residue: Native YD is read before assignment in two input-dependent RR1 calls. A retained sNaN-initialized native harness traps at the read. GPU uses a named quiet-NaN residue for those paths; no invented hydrologic value. Real captured formal outputs exclude no words.

soil_cadence.licence: Existing pinned WRF public-domain v4 sources and Registry; no additional code or tables.
soil_cadence.clock: Binary32 division and native positive NINT; absolute timestep determines reset and update. All nine native accumulators persist through checkpoint, restart, feedback and optional extended history.
soil_cadence.default: soiltstep=0 adds no arrays or selector identity; default CUDA sources unchanged.

tile_drainage.licence: Pinned WRF v4 public-domain distribution; source and MPTABLE original notice inspected before reuse; no new physics table
tile_drainage.translation: Complete TILE_DRAIN, TILE_HOOGHOUDT, TD_EQUIVALENT_DEPTH and TD_FINDZWAT, including all six layer-selection branches and native bounds

math.licence: Arm optimized-routines MIT; complete original notice reread before reuse

tile_drainage.state: TD_FRACTION, QTDRAIN, ZWT; conditional resident state, native cold initialization, both feedback modes, checkpoint/restart/history and independent ensembles
tile_drainage.undefined_local: Native equivalent-depth I is unassigned outside the X>.5 series; it is read only if the computed equivalent depth is negative. Published positive tables in the qualified calls produce positive depth; no undefined formal word is excluded.
tile_drainage.signed_zero: Strict real capture found one QSUBC word: native MIN(CANICE/DT,QSUBC) chooses its second operand on equal signed zero. Complete selected CANWATER retains that native tie; default source is untouched.
